description: A photograph showing the interior of a dense forest composed of tall, slender broadleaved trees. The tree trunks are a light greyish-brown and rise vertically, forming a high canopy of green foliage, some with hints of yellowing. The ground is thickly covered with fallen, dry brown leaves, indicative of late summer or autumn conditions. The trees appear to be mature and are uniformly spaced, consistent with descriptions of extensively managed semi-natural broadleaved forests found in European environmental classifications.
